name: Sgt. Weaver
summary: A sergeant in Larry's operations section, an ex-Marine, photographed at the flight-scheduling boards inside the radio van (VN-0014). He was an E5 at the time of the bathroom shooting at Tân Sơn Nhứt and was the sergeant who showed up while the drunk gunman still had the pistol out — a central witness to that incident.
larrysRecollection: Sargent Weaver / Ex-Marine (VN-0014 Memories comment, 2026-08-15). From the bathroom-shooting account, same day: "Sargent Weaver showed up. He was an E5."
researchNotes: Unusually well-anchored for an unresolved person: the 2026-08-09 vision survey independently read the VN-0014 name tape as beginning 'WE...' before Larry supplied 'Weaver' — testimony and photograph converge. If the bathroom-shooting court-martial record is found (unresolved #11), Weaver should appear in it as a witness. His '...CONTROL' pocket patch in VN-0014 is a magnification target that could carry the unit designation.
